description: This PHP source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams used for filtering search parameters related to performance tracker entities within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends a base FilterParams class, specifies allowed sorting fields, and manages an employee number filter property.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for defining search filters and sorting options for performance tracker entities, including filtering by employee number and default sorting settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
